prayerExcerpt.en-US: "My mother, who loved me, taught me virtue from the cradle, raised me in the knowledge of God, and gave me holy charity for my guide."
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: "Minha mãe, que me amava, desde o berço me ensinou a virtude, criou-me na ciência de Deus e me deu por guia a santa caridade."

meta.face: A Venezuelan of about fifty of Andean and Canarian stock with a warm, light-olive complexion and a SMOOTH, ROUND face, FULL through the cheeks, with a small, rounded chin — large, dark, GENTLE eyes with slightly HEAVY upper lids, dark brows that RISE a little at their inner ends, giving a mild, compassionate look, a short, straight nose, a neat, full, dark MOUSTACHE trimmed straight over a closed mouth, short dark hair under the hat; clean-shaven otherwise; the gaze calm, grave and kind. Not the square, tousled, laughing artemide_zatti of this batch.
meta.basis: His photographs (Wikimedia Commons: the head-and-shoulders portrait in hat and suit, the full-length photograph; the Dicastery's portrait): a smooth, round face with full cheeks, large, gentle, heavy-lidded eyes under brows raised at the inner ends, a short straight nose and a neat dark moustache, in a black suit and hat. The Dicastery records his teaching and practice in Caracas and his care of the poor.
meta.excerpt: His words «Mi madre que me amaba, desde la cuna me enseñó la virtud, me crió en la ciencia de Dios, y me puso de guía la santa caridad», as the Venezuelan foundation josegregorio.org and the Diario de Los Andes give them (Italian on the Dicastery's page); our renderings from the Spanish (he died in 1919)
